assertion_analysis.assertions: version increment, one hold, literal backend alpha (unchanged assertions reached through new mutable load)
assertion_analysis.fails_if: Hold write stops advancing the mutable version, inserts zero/duplicate holds, or records another backend; no expectation is passed to a mocked writer.

assertion_analysis.assertions: raises LedgerError, roster version changed text, literal worker-a/worker-b set
assertion_analysis.fails_if: Removing optimistic version refusal accepts the stale replacement, or a partial mutation removes worker-b; identities are independently specified literals.

assertion_analysis.assertions: aggregate absent before/after and independently captured auxiliary snapshot unchanged
assertion_analysis.fails_if: Run append creates a legacy aggregate or changes mutable members/holds/version while writing run files.

assertion_analysis.assertions: fresh auxiliary read equals pre-dispatch snapshot
assertion_analysis.fails_if: Session capture mutates the authoritative roster; the snapshot was observed before the dispatch, not supplied as the operation's expected output.

assertion_analysis.assertions: reader snapshot equality after deleting, importing history and explicitly restoring roster
assertion_analysis.fails_if: History import drops or changes run IDs/gate counts/version, roster restoration does not persist the supplied members, or readers lose identities; roster equality alone is a round-trip preservation check and does not prove automatic roster recovery after deleting the authority.

assertion_analysis.assertions: existing aggregate gate-update and stale-file refusal assertions with added authoritative row seed
assertion_analysis.fails_if: Mixing file and roster versions, overwriting collections or ignoring stale aggregate versions still fails; seeding a store row only makes the production lookup reach the same run.

assertion_analysis.assertions: literal selected run identities for stored and legacy paths, version 7, auxiliary version 8 or 7, literal registered/permanent/session-idle identities
assertion_analysis.fails_if: Wrong history source, omitted plan propagation, lost roster overlay, or mixed versions changes independently chosen identities/versions; expected run IDs are not passed to ledger.load as its answer.

assertion_analysis.assertions: observed equals independently read pre-probe snapshot and committed write count equals independently counted seed members+holds
assertion_analysis.fails_if: Restoring decode inside read-only BEGIN or mutable BEGIN IMMEDIATE makes the zero-timeout writer raise database-is-locked before either assertion; omitting decoding leaves too few writes; corrupting returned state fails snapshot equality.

assertion_independence: No added assertion is tautologically tied to an injected result. Pre-operation snapshots are observations, literal identities and versions are independent expectations, and the explicit roster restoration is identified as round-trip coverage rather than proof of recovery without a store.
